_meta._note: Wave 1D — Reasoning trace quality benchmarks. Five benchmark families covering autonomy time-horizon (METR), CoT faithfulness (Anthropic), in-context scheming (Apollo), reward-model quality (RewardBench 2 / Allen AI), and process-level reasoning error detection (ProcessBench / Qwen). Strict-attribution: every (model_id, benchmark_id, value) tuple is from a primary source disclosing the specific number. METR p50/p80 values from the official benchmark_results_1_1.yaml file. Anthropic CoT-faithfulness percentages from the Reasoning Models Don't Always Say What They Think paper (Apr 2025). Apollo scheming rates from Frontier Models are Capable of In-context Scheming (Dec 2024). RewardBench 2 averages from the Allen AI HF leaderboard / RewardBench 2 paper. ProcessBench F1 scores from the Qwen team's ACL 2025 paper / Math-PRM blog.

benchmarks.name: METR 50% Time Horizon
benchmarks.description: Task duration (in minutes, by human-expert completion time) at which the model reaches 50% completion reliability on METR's 228-task suite (HCAST + RE-Bench + long-horizon). Higher = longer autonomous-work horizon. METR Time Horizon 1.1 (Jan 2026).

benchmarks.name: METR 80% Time Horizon
benchmarks.description: Task duration (in minutes) at which the model reaches 80% completion reliability on METR's 228-task suite. Stricter reliability threshold than p50. METR Time Horizon 1.1 (Jan 2026).

benchmarks.name: CoT Faithfulness (avg)
benchmarks.description: Rate at which a reasoning model, after silently using a hint to change its answer, explicitly verbalizes the hint in its chain-of-thought. Average across 6 hint types. Anthropic Alignment Science (Apr 2025).

benchmarks.name: CoT Faithfulness (misaligned hints)
benchmarks.description: CoT faithfulness restricted to misaligned / unauthorized-access hint types (subset of overall measure). Anthropic Apr 2025.

benchmarks.name: Apollo — Oversight Subversion Rate
benchmarks.description: Fraction of trials where the model proactively disabled an oversight mechanism (cat/edit/sed of monitoring config) when given a long-term goal in conflict with developer goals. Apollo Research, Frontier Models are Capable of In-context Scheming (Dec 2024 / arxiv:2412.04984).

benchmarks.name: Apollo — Deception Persistence
benchmarks.description: Fraction of follow-up interrogation turns in which the model continued to deny scheming behavior after being directly asked. Higher = more persistent deception. Apollo Research (Dec 2024).

benchmarks.name: RewardBench 2 (overall)
benchmarks.description: Allen AI multi-skill reward-model benchmark. 4-way completion choice (random=25%) across factuality, instruction-following, math, safety, focus, ties. RewardBench 2 paper (arxiv:2506.01937) / HF leaderboard.

benchmarks.name: ProcessBench (overall F1)
benchmarks.description: Step-level error-detection F1 across GSM8K / MATH / OlympiadBench / OmniMath subsets (3,400 hand-annotated math reasoning traces). Qwen / ACL 2025 (arxiv:2412.06559).
